title: IndusInd Avios Visa Infinite credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: An Avios Visa Infinite variant providing elevated Avios earn rates, global lounge access, and milestone perks for frequent international flyers.

mileStoneItems.benefits: 5,000 Bonus Avios would be credited after 15 days of receipt of renewal fees for Qatar Airways Privilege Club as Preferred Airline Loyalty Programme or 5,000 Bonus Avios would be credited after 15 days of receipt of renewal fees for British Airways Executive Club as Preferred Airline Loyalty Programme.
20,000 bonus for choosing Qatar Airways Privilege Club as Preferred Airline Loyalty Programme or 20,000 bonus for choosing British Airways Executive Club as Preferred Airline Loyalty Programme.
